coordinate_system: Unscaled1024x1536 canvas; x right/y down; left/right mean image sides. Pixel centers are integer coordinates.

authority.basis: Locked face_shape01 and anatomical whole-face review. The axis is authored from the fixed face, not recomputed from an alpha bounding box, feature ink centroid, importer transform or rig constant.
authority.user_direction: 2026-11-09 latest explicit user instruction: 不对称，你生成一边镜像一下不就好了吗. Single-side mirroring is authorized and supersedes the prior default no-mirror constraint. For current natural01/04/05assets, select complete imageLEFT eyes and imageRIGHT brows, preserve original-sideRGBA and reflect the complete counterpart aboutx513 (x_prime=1026-x), including catchlights. Do not reconfirm authorized work, regenerate/blur the painting, individually stretch eyes or reuse rejected generated artwork. Source quality, clarity, expression and final user aesthetic judgment remain separate requirements.
authority.face_reference_rows_note: Existing face and jaw observation supports approximatelyx513. Ear/hair/neck extents and transparent margins must not redefine the facial axis.

tolerance_interpretation: Approximately1px natural/reading variation is tolerated. Pairwise contour readings allow2px and width probes2.5px; larger differences hold for repair/review. Thresholds are transparent pixel/gray-value gates, not a synthetic symmetry score. Even all numerical gates passing requires native-scale visual acceptance. A changed SHA always requires remeasurement and independent re-review.

eyes.method: MeanRGB darkness times alpha. Pupil100, extent170, eyelid ink-envelope190; fixed ROI with alpha floor24. The1/99% pigment span and5/95% vertical quantiles are screening proxies, never anatomical corner or lid replacements.

brows.method: MeanRGB<170 weighted by alpha; span1/99% ink quantiles. Semantic head/crest/tail plus three paired thickness/depth readings and whole-face review are required separately.

nose.method: MeanRGB darkness150 times alpha; actual paired nostril centroid midpoint is an axis proxy; semantic nostrils and lower center still required.

mouth.method: MeanRGB darkness160 times alpha in lip seam ROI; dark seam center is only an axis proxy and requires semantic seam center/corners plus whole-face review.

beard.method: Separate upper/lower bands, meanRGB darkness170 times alpha.1/99% ink extents give midpoint screens. Each region actually present needs its own semantic center; cheek/jaw reach and lip compatibility require native-scale whole-face review.

beard_points: upper_center:[x,y] semantic midpoint for actual upper region; philtrum may be transparent
upper_endpoints:[L,R] actual paired pigment endpoints if upper region present
lower_center:[x,y] semantic center for actual lower region
lower_endpoints:[L,R] actual paired pigment endpoints if lower region present
measurement_schema.reading_note: Eye lid samples progress25/50/75% from inner corner toward outer corner for each eye. Read complete upper/lower contour, iris exposure/occlusion, and brow anatomy from actual current PNGs; no template target points or old transform residuals count as observations.

composition_required: input_hashes:{relativefile:SHA256} for all configured feature files, fixed head and all front/back hair
visual_review_schema.evidence_path_rule: With a review in qa/, evidence files are relative to its parent package; otherwise relative to the review JSON directory. Contact sheets are allowed; records must describe actual normal-scale inspection, not claim hashes prove symmetry.
